# Paths excluded from TruffleHog secret scanning.
#
# TruffleHog matches these as regular expressions (one per line, blank lines
# and lines starting with '#' are ignored). This is NOT glob syntax — dots
# must be escaped where you want a literal dot.
#
# Ported from the [allowlist] block in .github/gitleaks.toml.

# Original gitleaks allowlist entry.
\.pre-commit-config\.yaml

# The scanner configs themselves contain regex patterns and keywords
# ("password", "token", "key", sample IPs, ...) that would self-trigger the
# custom detectors defined in .github/trufflehog.yaml.
\.github/trufflehog\.yaml
\.github/trufflehog-exclude\.txt
\.github/gitleaks\.toml

# The generated CycloneDX SBOM legitimately contains dependency URLs and
# author names — not secrets.
bom\.cdx\.json
